# AortaCFD v1.2.0 — Configuration validation + UX polish

This release hardens the configuration pipeline against silent misconfigurations and adds three new CLI flags for faster iteration. **No breaking changes for existing v1.1.x configs that were already correctly set up.**

## Headline changes

- **Configs fail fast, not at hour 17.** Unknown `inlet.profile`, `physics.rans_model`, or `physics.les_model` values now raise at config-build time with the allowed list — typos like `walldistance` or `wale` (wrong case) no longer fall through silently to defaults or produce cryptic OpenFOAM errors. The unphysical *pulsatile inlet + `zeroGradient` outlets* combination is also rejected up-front, with a remediation pointer to Windkessel.

- **Three new CLI flags for development speed:**
  - `--end-time T` overrides the simulation duration from the command line (no more editing `controlDict` for short smoke tests).
  - `--max-runs N` prunes oldest `run_*/` siblings after a fresh run (each AortaCFD run is ~150 MB; this keeps disk in check during iterative work).
  - `--doctor` runs environment diagnostics — Python version, importable deps, sample STLs, OpenFOAM sourced, disk space — useful for new users debugging their setup.

- **`inlet.type: 'MAPPED_PROFILE'`** is the new (clearer) name for what was confusingly called `MRI`. The branch consumes pre-mapped per-face per-timestep boundary data; the source can be 4D MRI, Doppler, a 1D model, anything that produces `timeVaryingMappedFixedValue` snapshots. `MRI` keeps working as a deprecated alias (warns on use) and will be removed in v2.0.

## Numbers

- **2188 unit tests pass** (was 2168 in v1.1.1) — 20 new tests cover the config matrix axes (inlet types, outlet types, physics, numerics) and the schema validators.
- **3 live-solver integration runs verified converging** end-to-end on real OpenFOAM 12: RAS k-ω-SST (BPM120), LES WALE (BPM120), MAPPED_PROFILE inlet (VOL04).
- **3 tutorial-coarse benchmark tests** validate `pressure_drop_mean`, `wss_p99`, and `outlet4 ΔP` against a 2026-04-09 reference run with ±10–20% tolerances.

## Bug fixes

- `WkSetup` flow-split rejects negative inputs (previously a typo like `{"outlet1": -20, "outlet2": 120}` produced negative R/C/Z and the solver diverged silently).
- `compute_inward_normal` falls back to legacy heuristics when STL surfaces are missing (covers test fixtures and partial pipelines).
- `psutil` now properly declared as a runtime dependency (was being pulled in transitively).
- `tests.yml --cov-fail-under` aligned to `60` matching `pyproject.toml`; `release.yml` now enforces coverage + lint + Bandit gates before publishing.

## Known limitations carried over to v1.2.1

- **Production-mesh benchmark** (BPM120 default config, 1.9M cells, 3 cycles, Wang et al. Table 3 values) is **deferred** — it needs ~10–25 h on HPC, not feasible on a laptop. The tutorial-coarse benchmark is the v1.2.0 live-validation reference.
- `zeroGradient` outlets are documented as fragile on severe-stenosis geometries regardless of inlet type. Use Windkessel for clinical work.
